name: claude-tools
description: prime's home-made Claude Code mods and skills

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Context card above the prompt, off until /context-bar show or the showBand option: the window as one bar segmented by /context category (system prompt, tools, MCP, agents, memory, skills, messages, free), a legend, a fill badge coloured by threshold, plus session tokens, cost and rate limits; /context-bar for the breakdown

plugins.name: resource-monitor
plugins.description: CPU and memory of Claude Code and the processes it starts: a Resources pane with sparklines, a status-line readout, warning colours, and a tool so Claude can answer about it

plugins.name: generate-docs
plugins.description: Skill: generate project or research documentation, or step-by-step guides with fill-in fields, as self-contained HTML, Markdown, PDF or a Claude artifact (system/light/dark theme, jump-to-section menu, shareable filled-in guides, no network calls)

plugins.name: daily-organizer
plugins.description: A Claude skill that keeps your personal daily organizer on claude.ai: Today, Up Next, Waiting On and Done lists that you and Claude both update, with a morning plan and an end-of-day summary.

plugins.name: jira-dashboard
plugins.description: A Claude skill that keeps a Jira dashboard on claude.ai: new, recently updated and your own tickets from your Jira site, refreshed each morning through the Atlassian connector, with a review mark that keeps unreviewed tickets as a backlog.

plugins.name: git-repo-creator
plugins.description: Skill: put a project on git and GitHub, or audit and fix an existing repo: name, description, visibility, license, .gitignore, README, CI workflow, and lockdown for public repos

plugins.name: project-progress
plugins.description: Skill and pane: track long project work in PROGRESS.md: one item at a time with a plan, park side ideas instead of chasing them, checkpoint before /clear; a Progress pane shows where you are
